notes.title: PHANTASMA VR DIRECTOR'S CUT
notes.content:
HaHAhaaHaaAAA ... The time has come. I worked my ass off to give you the best Phantasma version yet. 

[b]And We are BaCk In tImE for tHe SCreAM FeST with a 30% discount![/b]

[list]
[*]The [b]Puzzles are VERY less obtuse[/b] ... Thank God!

[b]HAPPY HALLOWEEN![/b]

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE - Official Oculus Support and More !
notes.content:
Finally, Phantasma is fully supporting the Oculus Rift. The game has been completely reworked and has seen a bunch of enhancements for the benefit of all players.

- The first hallway puzzle is giving more informations when you are using a door. It's subtle so listen and watch carefully but it is very important. You will no longer think you are the victim of a bug.

- You can now reset all your progress. You just need to type "bunny" on the keyboard anywhere in the game, Phantasma will quit and you will have a clean slate.

- A lot of little tweaks have been done to give you a better experience.

As always, watch for bugs and I will push an update to correct any problems as soon as possible.

Happy Halloween !

AnD rEmEMber To bE a GoOd BunNy !

notes.title: UPDATE INCOMING - Thanks to Beeper, a feature is coming !
notes.content:
Beeper's bad review made me think. I couldn't change the puzzle entirely but it was clear that I had to do something to alleviate the pain some players were in.

Now there is a sound and a camera effect to ease the player's way in the first hallway puzzle. You will now have a better understanding of how the doors are working and it will not seems like a bug anymore. 

Thanks Beeper !

notes.title: UPDATE - The teleporter pushing you back is GONE and the level select is LIVE !
notes.content:
Hello Bunnies, The title is already doing a great job explaining what are the majors changes of this new update. No more push back when you teleport near an object and for the smartest ones that have already finished the game, the level select is now available. Just finish the game once more and restart. 

The next update will focus on small details like fine tuning the teleport zone and a more precise grab method. If you see something wrong, let me know. I LOVE LOVE YOU !
